question: The total number of persons awarded under Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards - 2022, which was announced by the President of India on 25th January 2023, stood at ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__43__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The President of India has approved the conferment of **Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards - 2022 on 43 persons**.
 
• It includes **Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak to 07, Uttam Jeevan Raksha Padak to 08, and Jeevan Raksha Padak to 28 persons**.
 
• **Four awardees are posthumous**. 
 
• It is awarded for courage and promptitude in saving life from drowning, fire, rescue operations in mines, rescuer displayed in an act or a series of acts of human nature in saving life from drowning, fire rescue operations in mines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jeevan Raksha Padak series of awards are given to a person for a **meritorious act of human nature in saving the life of a person**. 
 
• The award is given in three categories, namely, Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak, Uttam Jeevan Raksha Padak, and Jeevan Raksha Padak. 
 
• Persons from all walks of life are eligible for these awards. 
 
• The award can also be conferred posthumously.
 
• The awardees are honored with a medal, a certificate signed by the Union Home Minister, and a lump sum monetary allowance.
 
• It is presented to the awardees in due course by the respective Union Ministries/Organizations/State Government to which the awardee belongs.
